abilities.name: Glacial Waltz

_curatorNotes: gcsim internal/characters/kaeya/burst.go Burst(): count = 3 icicles, offset = 120/count = 40f, each icicle re-queues burstTickerFunc every 120f — so a target at the front is hit every 40f (0.667s). First icicle fires at burstHitmark = 53f, which is this summon's authored spawnsAt, so firstTickDelay = (53 - 53)/60 = 0.
Scaling from zz_kaeya.dm.go `burst` array index 9 (talent level 10) = 1.3968 → 139.68%. Sidecar docs/curation/talents/kaeya.json talents.burst row "Skill DMG" 10th value = 139.7%.
Element/durability from the AttackInfo in Burst(): attributes.Cryo, Durability 25 (1U). ICDTag ElementalBurst / ICDGroupDefault = standard ICD, so no icdGate (measured verdict: standard).
C6 (Glacial Whirlwind) adds a 4th icicle, which changes the cadence to 30f — authored as the sibling series below; this one is gated to NOT C6.

tickCap 13 (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim burst.go sets `Status.Add(burstKey, burstDuration + burstHitmark + 1)` - 480 + 53 + 1 - and that trailing +1 is deliberate, so the 13th icicle at frame 533, exactly 8.000s after the first, still sees a live status. Our window is half-open [53, 533) and dropped it. This is the reference case for the boundary tick.

C6 variant of the series above. gcsim internal/characters/kaeya/burst.go Burst(): `if c.Base.Cons == 6 { count++ }` → count = 4, offset = 120/4 = 30f, so a front target is hit every 30f (0.5s). Same first icicle at burstHitmark = 53f = spawnsAt, so firstTickDelay = 0.
Same AttackInfo as C0 (Mult burst[TalentLvlBurst()], attributes.Cryo, Durability 25, ICDTag ElementalBurst / ICDGroupDefault) — only the emitter count changes.

tickCap 17 (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): the C6 series - four icicles at 30f offsets, each re-ticking every 120f inside the same `burstDuration + burstHitmark + 1` status. Measured 17 at C6 (5+4+4+4 across the four icicles); our duration-derived 16 was one short. Authored on this series rather than as a constellation override because the C6 cadence is already its own series.

C2 (Never-Ending Performance): duration extends +2.5s per kill during burst (max 15s, up to 3 extensions) — this is runtime-dynamic and cannot be represented as static durationModifiers. Reviewer to decide modeling approach.
gcsim burst frames ActionSkill (E) = 78 is AnimationLength default from InitAbilSlice(78) — not explicitly set, omitted.

nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim kaeya/burst.go queues the icicle ticker at burstHitmark 53 — the Glacial Waltz series; the cast lands nothing of its own.
abilities.description:
Coalescing the frost in the air, Kaeya summons 3 icicles that revolve around him.
These icicles will follow the character around and deal Cryo DMG to opponents in their path for the ability's duration.

Opponents Frozen by Frostgnaw will drop additional Elemental Particles.

constellations.name: Excellent Blood
_curatorNotes: Migrated 2026-05-10 (E2 follow-up): trigger manual → passive with `enemyAffectedBy: { element: 'cryo' }` condition (new primitive). Schema cannot scope CR to N/CA-only (no chargeCritRate / normalCritRate stat); buff over-renders against ALL Kaeya attacks. Acceptable since enemyAffectedBy itself renders optimistically. Frozen-tagged enemies carry Cryo aura in-game so the cryo condition covers both 'Cryo aura' and 'Frozen' description branches.
[caption-sweep 2026-07-20] Caveat added when constellation passive-trigger bonuses were wired into the Always-on caption: the null-resolving gate lists optimistically.
constellations.description: The CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charge Attacks against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.
constellations.caveat: Listed as always active; in game the CRIT Rate bonus only applies against opponents affected by Cryo.

constellations.name: Never-Ending Performance
constellations.description: While Glacial Waltz is in effect, for each opponent defeated, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.

notModeled.reason: This extends the burst only when an opponent is defeated, and the Rotation Planner doesn't model opponents being defeated.

constellations.name: Frozen Kiss
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-09 model-mismatch cleanup: rewrote the effect from `damage hp 30 target:enemy` to `shield self hp 30 duration:20`. The 250% Cryo absorption efficiency is not modelled (no per-element shield-efficiency primitive).

2026-05-11: `selfHpBelow: 20` condition added (E2 follow-up). Trigger now `passive` — renders optimistically as an always-active conditional shield with the HP gate caveat. The 60s ICD is not enforced; the planner doesn't model shield procCooldown for self-shield grants.
constellations.description:
Triggers automatically when Kaeya's HP falls below 20%:
Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of Kaeya's Max HP. Lasts for 20s.
This shield absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency.
Can only occur once every 60s.
